multilabel_metrics.reason: TCM-SD is single-label multiclass (one norm_syndrome per row).

model.inspired_by: Huang et al. 2022 Cross-FGCNN (JMIR Med Inform)

holdout_policy.validation_used_for: epoch model selection (best val accuracy) and reported metrics
holdout_policy.note: Same train/validation row partitions as RF / LR / SVM.

from_paper: Deep & Cross–style cross network (6 layers in paper; used here too)
FGCNN-style conv → pool → tanh recombination (3 stages)
Concatenate cross vector C with nonlinear vector F
MLP classifier + dropout 0.2 + Adam lr 0.001 + cross-entropy
adaptations: TCM-SD free text → 60 virtual character-position slots (not 60 TCM diagnostic fields)
Class-weighted cross-entropy for long-tailed TCM-SD labels
Epoch-based training with best-validation checkpoint (paper reported 1000 iterations)
LayerNorm inside cross layers + grad clipping for stability (not specified by Huang)
Character/bigram virtual field codes instead of clinician-coded symptom fields
huang_mapping.not_claimed: Exact numerical reproduction of Huang et al. dysmenorrhea results
